reused_semantics: Allocator output is decision support rather than autonomous execution.
Evidence provenance, source identity and freshness matter to allocation evidence.
Weak or missing evidence reduces allocation authority.
Forecasts and speculative signals are not realized cash.
Real resource/cash movement must cross governance and human approval boundaries.
Allocation authorization binds to an exact immutable plan.
Kill switches and stale-policy/evidence rechecks are part of execution governance.
deliberately_not_reused: The upstream composite portfolio score is not used as the Portfolio Brain cross-project allocation oracle.
Portfolio Brain uses resource-specific Pareto layers and explicit share-conversion rules instead of one cross-resource scalar score.
